about: Reference projects Crucix learns from. Run `node scripts/watchlist.mjs` to see what changed in each since it was last reviewed; `node scripts/watchlist.mjs --mark <id>` records a review. Add a project by adding an entry (keep ids unique).

projects.name: awesome-osint-arsenal
projects.whyWatch: A catalogue of 750+ OSINT tools and sources; new keyless data sources and lookup pages show up here first.

adopted.what: pivot links (Look up elsewhere) in the record inspector
ThreatFox and Have I Been Pwned sources
MISP Galaxy threat actor groups on the country sheet

projects.droppedOrOpen: Most entries are person, phishing or red-team tools that do not fit Crucix. Measured and dropped: Feodo Tracker (5 entries), GLEIF on-demand, Malpedia, ransomware feeds without a licence check.

lastReviewed.note: Full analysis behind v2.14.0 to v2.17.0; head was from 2026-08-29.

projects.name: World Monitor
projects.whyWatch: The closest relative: a real-time global intelligence dashboard with a large source catalogue (docs/data-sources.mdx), country scoring and many panels. New sources, feeds and algorithms appear weekly.

adopted.what: tiered RSS feed registry with source tiers, Hungarian outlets
U.S. travel advisories as a risk component
GPSJam GNSS interference, WMO SWIC warnings

projects.droppedOrOpen: Dropped: NGA navigational warnings (newest active one is from 2024), UK FCDO and Smartraveller feeds, the CII v8 score (Crucix keeps its own transparent model), TeleGeography cables (proprietary). Open ideas: more of docs/data-sources.mdx (central banks, CFTC, UNHCR, FAA delays, disease outbreaks), the panels in docs/panels, multi-word keyword entities.

lastReviewed.note: Full analysis behind v2.18.0 to v2.23.0 (shallow clone of 2026-10-07).

projects.name: God's Eye View
projects.license: NOASSERTION (check the repository before copying anything)
projects.whyWatch: A browser spy-satellite simulator on a 3D globe with live open spatial data; a source of visualisation ideas and data feeds.
projects.droppedOrOpen: Not analysed yet. First step: clone it into a temporary folder and compare its data sources and map layers with Crucix. The licence is not stated (NOASSERTION): take ideas and public data sources, not code, until it is checked.
